ns2:course.label: Graphic Design Practicum
ns2:course.description: This analytical studio prepares students for entry into the field of graphic design. Professional practice is parsed into areas of opportunity, to which students ultimately align themselves and by which they structure their preparatory endeavors. Prerequisite: ARTD 207 and ARTD 333. For majors only.
ns2:course.courseSectionInformation: Prerequisite: ARTD 207 and ARTD 333. For majors only.
